name: table-summary-strip
title: Table summary strip
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A KPI strip for the top of a table. Wraps stat-strip with loading, an error retry, explicit zeros, and an optional sparkline on each item.

meta.titleEs: Franja de cifras de la tabla
meta.descriptionEs: Cifras para ir arriba de una tabla. Envuelve la franja de cifras con carga, reintento, ceros explícitos y una tendencia opcional por cifra.

examples.title: Franja de cifras de la tabla
examples.description: La franja encima de las tablas existentes, con estado y tendencia.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, ceros, 390 px, RTL y un slot por cifra.

api.name: items
api.description: StatStrip items plus an optional sparkline and sparklineLabel.

api.name: loading
api.description: Skeletons and a visible loading status. Motion is skipped when reduced.

api.name: error / onRetry
api.description: Replaces the figures with an alert and a retry button.

api.name: empty
api.description: hide removes a blank strip. show keeps explicit zeros.

api.name: renderItem
api.description: Optional slot under each item, next to the sparkline.

api.name: variant / locale / className / classNames / labels
api.description: Passed through to stat-strip. labels.loading and labels.retry are the status strings.

docs: Clean-room helper for a KPI strip above a table. Shadcn Studio Pro was not purchased, fetched, or ported. No source, sample rows, icons, or assets were copied. Compose it with the leading slot on data-table, expandable-table, work-table, or adaptive-table, and put StatusActionCell plus DataTableSparkline in the columns. This is not a new table. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, skeleton, stat-strip, or data-table-reorder. The item ships no theme. Numbers use tabular-nums. The strip wraps; it does not scroll sideways.
